description: Authoritative machine-readable SDLC state machine of ai-sdlc-factory: the 15 runs.status states and the 15 legal transitions between them. State order is the order of the runs.status CHECK constraint in migrations/postgres/0002_init_tasks_and_sdlc.up.sql. docs/architecture/SDLC_STATE_MACHINE.md section 3 mirrors this file and the migration tests fail when the two drift. Initiators: run_workflow (advanced by the run workflow), human_approval (a decision recorded in the approval queue), external_evidence (a fact produced outside the platform, for example CI result or deploy healthcheck), scheduled (a time-based trigger). Error semantics: error.status is always stay_in_state (a rejected transition never moves the run), error.audit is always true (every rejected attempt is written to audit_log), error.escalation is none, max_rounds (the review loop reached max_rounds, section 7) or max_steps_or_cost (the workflow passed its step or budget limit, section 6). Every transition is additionally bounded by the StageRun deadline and the circuit breakers of section 7.

transitions.condition: Run started with the owner goal; the problem description is captured (section 2).
Research report produced from the hypothesis; findings recorded (section 2).
PRD, SLPr v1 and user stories produced (section 2).
requirements_approved gate passes: approve plus resolved comments (section 4). A rejection returns the notes to the PM.
AM v1, C4 diagrams and ADR produced (section 2); the AM change passes the semantic_valid inference rules (section 4).
architecture_approved gate passes: approve plus a valid AM (section 4). A rejection returns the notes to the architect.
Epics, tasks and the sprint plan produced (section 2).
PR opened; ci_green gate passes: all CI checks green (section 4); new code coverage >= 80%; Conventional Commits observed.
review_approved gate passes: approval from a reviewer that is not the PR author (section 4); max_rounds=3 (section 7). Changes requested return the notes to the author.
qa_passed gate passes: all test levels green, coverage thresholds met, critical/high bugs closed (section 4). Critical defects or test failures block the run (section 5).
Image, RC and SBOM produced (section 2); sbom_signed gate passes: SBOM present and image signed (section 4).
prod_approved gate passes: human approve (R3); release notes in KB; DB migrations verified (section 4). A rejection returns the notes to the release manager.
deploy_healthy gate passes: healthcheck plus metrics normal (section 4).

Monitoring reports produced feedback tasks; the scheduled feedback review starts the next Research cycle (same run: a new Research StageRun of the same run, not a new run; feedback loop of section 1).
